title: Jesus... I'm Staying Back For Diwali And Everyone's Gone Home
topic: his first Diwali away from home, staying back while everyone goes home and pretending he prefers the quiet

bible.text: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... everyone's going home for Diwali. Why am I pretending I like the quiet? 🪔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You refreshed your train app four times today. That wasn't rest.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So I tell Amma I'm not coming? My first Diwali away.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Make the call. She wants your voice, not guilt money.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what's Diwali in an empty room?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Light one lamp where you are. Festivals don't need a full house.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are the light of the world. Even a city of one needs light.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: First festival away from home too? What would you light first? 👇
